notes.title: Release status
notes.notes:
Hello all, 

So the Series of Events release is going to take a little longer than originally anticipated. This is due to the way that I'll need to deliver the game in it's early access, which in truth won't feel very early access when it's done as I am required to complete the initial five starting points and then release via DLC (Which will be free, but I'll come onto that below)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/d02535fa7062e9eb28c4370d2a0df6816cbad970.jpg[/img]

So, in order to release the game at all, I need to first finish the five starting points which is around 23 separate stories where you will see, depending on your choices - Jessica taking a job with an adult film studio, getting a massage after training with her PT and deciding to go further or not, taking a job at the local pizza place, visiting her doctors, being tangled up in a mess of revenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033602/482a401a0027a75a07f2ce96cc38d22bc3519aac.jpg[/img]

So DLC, DLC will be free for this game which will have the next choices available for you to choose from, once they have been reviewed and approved for release. 

Now that I have figured this out and providing some details about everything that is important to the game, I'll be sure to update this page and announcements on news and events that directly effect the release.

Thank you,
DoAdventures
